name: Sonoda Kaori
source:
She has a gentle, laid-back personality.
She has no complaints about her husband Hiro
and is living a happy life.
She previously dated Hiro’s close friend Masato Satou.

[Translated from [url=https://amatures.ohimesama.net/midara/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
